title: Spotify Event Delivery And Personalization
summary: How listen events become isolated data products for analytics, recommendations, and artist insights.

nodes.label: Client events
nodes.description: Listening, ad, playlist, search, and operational events from clients and services.

nodes.label: Event Service
nodes.description: Parses event types, rejects malformed data, and routes each type separately.

nodes.label: Cloud Pub/Sub
nodes.description: Each event type gets an isolated topic, ETL path, and storage target.

nodes.label: ETL jobs
nodes.description: Dedicated jobs bucket, deduplicate, encrypt, and deliver event data.

nodes.label: GCS + BigQuery
nodes.description: Storage and warehouse tables support data science, analytics, and product teams.

nodes.label: Personalization
nodes.description: Discovery surfaces, mixes, ads, and artist insights consume the data products.

steps.title: Collect listening signals
steps.description: Spotify treats event delivery as core infrastructure because product learning starts with reliable events.

steps.title: Isolate event types early
steps.description: Cloud Pub/Sub topics separate noisy and business-critical events so one stream does not block all others.

steps.title: Deliver durable buckets
steps.description: Dedicated ETL jobs close immutable buckets and make events safe for downstream consumers.

steps.title: Feed personalization
steps.description: Warehouse and lakehouse data power discovery, analytics, ads, and artist-facing insights.

steps.title: Measure new behavior
steps.description: The next listening session becomes the next signal for measuring and improving the product.
